newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian ARS says plans $100 mln Eurobond.
newsitem.headline: Russian ARS says plans $100 mln Eurobond.

text.p: Russia's main diamond producer Almazy Rossii-Sakha (ARS) plans to issue a $100 million Eurobond by the end of 1997, its vice-president said on Thursday.
"We are preparing a Eurobond project and propose issuing Eurobonds by the end of the year," Semyon Zelberg told Reuters.
Zelberg said ARS, which is about to sign an agreement with South African diamond giant De Beers, planned to increase borrowing through Eurobond issues to fund its investment projects.
"If we start with $100 million in 1997, later the volume of borrowing may grow up to $300 million annually," he said.
Zelberg said the company was collecting bids for lead-managing the issue and would choose banks on May 20.
"We shall choose two banks out of five or six," he said.
Zelberg said SBC Warburg, National Westminster Bank, Salomon Brothers and Smith Barney were among the bidders.
